ribose.label: sourced

cysteine.label: sourced
cysteine.note: Muroya 2019 Table 1: 1.6 nmol/g at D0 to 107 nmol/g at D14, n = 3 steers, CE-TOFMS (D0 at the detection floor); Koutsidis 2008b Table 4: 0.05-0.16 mmol/kg over 21 d, n = 16, GC-MS; Koutsidis 2008a Table 3: 0.05-0.17 mmol/kg across 30 steers at 10 d, whose top is the upper corner (0.23 mM); the span is ageing plus animal spread

thiamine.label: sourced
thiamine.note: Lombardi-Boccia 2005 Table 2: total thiamine 0.01-0.08 (+/- 0.01) mg/100 g across five raw beef cuts by HPLC after acid hydrolysis, lowest mean to highest mean + SD; not detected in any cut after cooking; about twofold below the stub

glucose.label: sourced
